title: Research: audit native transport and helper-300 successor boundaries
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add `research/helper-transport-contract`, a scoped construction, native-operator audit and exact cost comparison following the helper-300 twenty-field investigation. **No improved κ or admitted replacement supplier is claimed.**

- A rank-zero physical warp between the selected source lines changes the logical value. An exact one-way value-preserving repair costs one H2 plus two monomial adapters; full tableau and absolute phase are checked.
- The nominated successor born at plane 430 fails monotone reachability. Birth and old-helper retirement at line 21 give an exact **21-input local replacement at 38 H1**; retaining retirement at plane 430 costs 39 H1.
- The local cut identity does not establish productive admission for the original helper. Exact source extraction identifies the 16 main-input terms in the cut value and the original helper's external role-505 coupling. Input rebasing is legitimate, but the complete producer/decoder and caller equation remain open.
- Directed rational bounds price the conditional regrouping allowance at approximately 0.07703787664 per LOCAL. Even granting the maximal single rank-nine target-split credit, one extra H1 per LOCAL loses; a once-global H2 exceeds all eighteen combined allowances. A once-global H1 is not excluded arithmetically.

The isolated clean-contact obstruction and specified formal exit-shear test are narrowly scoped. They do not prove a general impossibility for coordinated changed words or a lower bound for the unconstructed true decoder.

## Task and overlap

Task: `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, priority revision 7; **scope changed** by explicit assignment from fixed-boundary floors to native transport and productive-input ownership. The original card's supplier acceptance gate is not claimed.

Scientific base: `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`, refreshed before submission. Sources, hashes and replay inputs are recorded in `SOURCES.json` and `VERIFY.json`. The concrete source block is backward interval `[9044,9137)`, with twenty continuing fields and one arbitrary successor input.

Canonical investigation: [Discussion #5470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5470).

Nearest predecessors:
- #5472, GamingPuzzled, head `ce96fe9747ea0643bd8c30d448c1ba8e2b30ac30`: the entrance-pure successor pattern is credited there; its novelty is not claimed here.
- #5471, head `77d29520c4f90a65787873d6becc205796630c23`: eight-field fixed-boundary floor.
- [Twenty-field floor](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/tree/2f586ad5253a0a8065bf444f33f728b93129b0ed/research/helper300-twenty-field-floor), head `2f586ad5253a0a8065bf444f33f728b93129b0ed`.

These pending artifacts provide motivation and attribution, not scientific replay dependencies. This package adds the named source interface, exact native repair and conditional cost comparison.

## Validation

Tested commit: `2f3a551d74ac0bb30f6e055bcc7f13f5e92dfb03`. CPython 3.12.14, macOS arm64, standard library only.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/helper-transport-contract
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/helper-transport-contract --check-source-history
```

All six registered commands pass. Normal and optimized structured outputs agree in a Git-free, read-only committed export; all 21 exported payloads, including the receipt, remain unchanged. Failure controls cover six boundary mutations, four accounting mutations, native phase/wrong-repair cases, three changed-provider rejections and a changed compiler rejected before import. Committed-byte/source-history preflight and official export integrity pass.

These are exact scoped identity, source and budget checks, not formal verification of the full multiplication theorem. No complete provider/caller, owned-relations, all-width physical compiler, Lean, Docker, hosted CI or new exponent replay is claimed.

## Credit

Prepared by **apoursh** with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance from a coordinator and separate native, source-interface and arithmetic workers. Worker separation is not independent human or formal-kernel review. Apache-2.0.

Retains credit to Cao Yifan's provider (#4610), Dillon Amburgey's coupled completion (#5402), Ali Romman's cached-centre relations, Chris R/Clear1nsight's caller and exact arithmetic (#5413), zxv's native interpreter, GamingPuzzled's reorder/successor work (#5465/#5472), and the retained compiler lineage through Cinna Davis (#2226), Rohan Arun and Tekalign. Source notices are declared export inputs; the README gives the detailed attribution.

## Open next questions

See the README and `TASK.json`. The smallest useful next step is to exhibit complete entrance/exit maps satisfying `E_out W_new E_in = D_new` for every original and successor input, including role 505, with all paid, target, ownership and caller obligations accounted for. This is the missing link between the local identity and a productive split.

A separately scoped possibility is one genuinely shared transport across all eighteen LOCALs. The arithmetic leaves room for one global H1, but no shared operator or information-dimension argument is supplied.
